dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing from the wide mid-body section toward the posterior peduncle region.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Gradient from dark grey-blue anteriorly to light grey/off-white posteriorly; median baseline is mid-grey.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse lighter patches distributed along the mid-dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slope with smooth transitions between darker pigmented anterior and lighter posterior regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Small, high-contrast white punctate marks aligned linearly along the mid-dorsal ridge.
